artboards.title: Pure row; gate in the head

annotations.text:
Design pass: gate triage modal (board).
Direction ratified 2026-09-09: TRIAGE QUEUE. One modal session walks every pending gate on the board; pips track gates, dots track questions inside the active gate, footer peeks the next gate. Buttons take the mantine-style light variant (color at low alpha, no edge).
Next: spec every state as Storybook stories for sign-off, then implement.
Baseline PNGs of all 22 catalog stories: docs/design/gate-cards/baseline/.

Actions live at their own level now: gate-level (focus pane, skip gate) as ghost buttons on the gate strip; step-level (previous, solid next) in the footer; reset as ghost text. Queue pips moved to the header beside the count.
Queue semantics ratified 2026-09-09:
1. Entry: both a header triage button (starts at gate 1) and a row's gate chip (enters positioned at that gate).
2. Skip gate: advance only; the skipped gate and its draft stay untouched.
3. Scope: all actionable gates on visible rows (respects filters), board order.

Pass input 2: dark contrast on the cards. Left column is today's exact values; right lifts row and control edges, brightens muted text, amber wash on the checked row, light-variant buttons. Exact values in the legends. After sign-off these land as board CSS (or kit token) tweaks and apply to cards and modal alike.
Console: the same kit adapter renders the queue inside a Mantine Modal with the console's existing questionnaire styling. Specced after the board stories.

Mini-pass on the orientation strip. Ruling: it should BE the MR row users already scan (title line + the row-2 meta line, byte-identical values) so nobody learns a second surface. Status chips, pipeline state and the badge row stay on the main view only; the row here carries identity facts, not live status.
Open question: where the gate-only bits live (kind, focus pane, skip gate). Pips and count stay in the modal head either way.

Row + gate cluster inline: the kind and the two ghost actions ride the title line's right edge, like badges do on a real row.
Tradeoff: a long title competes with the cluster for line-1 width.

Pure row; gate in the head: the strip is only the MR row; kind joins the head after the pips, actions sit left of the close button.
Tradeoff: gate identity is farther from the row it gates; head gets busier.
